title: NICL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
summary: National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) , has released a Notification on its Official Website for the recruitment of Apprentice Posts . This recruitment is for 200 positions. The NICL application form has started on 04 November 2026, and candidates can apply until 18 November 2026. The minimum age is 21 Years & the maximum age is 30 years as on 01 April 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the NICL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 provided below.
qualification: Candidates having Graduation degree in any stream from any recognized university / college.
